title: The gathering-pose registry (stand-in made / making / failed)
oneLine: Per-pose idle/loading/ready/failed record with a generation counter and 15 s retry for the chop, cook, fire and farm stand-ins.
topConcern: A make whose fetch never settles stays 'loading' for the session (no timeout); degrades to the walking body.

title: Today's town's NPC and building art (load, ready, free, unloading)
oneLine: Old town's scenery load/free with _town, _townReady and _townUnload; skipped on the live trip to the Wheel.
topConcern: Unreachable 'superseded while loading' branch would leave stills in _tex if it ever ran.

title: The Wheel's townsfolk photographs (skipped for live drawing, loaded late, freed with the Wheel)
oneLine: Whether the Wheel cast's photographs are held: skipped when drawn live, loaded late when switched off, freed with the Wheel.
topConcern: loadWheelNpcArt(true) drops a skipped run without releasing what it loaded; latent while every townsperson has a look.

title: Per-zone decor props (load behind the overlay, free on exit)
oneLine: Frost's decor sprites loaded per zone into the NPC registry and unloaded on exit.
topConcern: A free overlapping an in-flight load republishes a destroyed texture (no generation check); frost only.

title: Global one-shot art loads (capes, pets, shields, weapons, NPC portraits)
oneLine: Five load-once memos on the loading screen, each with a different failure policy.
topConcern: A dropped request for a cape facing, weapon or shield view is never retried in the session; the pet sheet's retry has no later caller.

title: NFT 360-degree avatar textures, per avatar URL
oneLine: Per-URL absent/loading/ready/failed cache of NFT avatar textures for the sprite-path fallback.
topConcern: Uncapped cache keyed by peer-supplied URLs, fetched by every viewer on the fallback path.

title: Fighter capture hand-off (the Points window's photographed swing, roll, jog and films)
oneLine: Registered renderer handles plus a 16-entry LRU of filmed effect strips for the stat scene.
topConcern: Handles are not cleared on renderer destroy; captures in the gap hit a destroyed renderer (caught).

title: Form shading's figure registry
oneLine: Figures listed when first shaded, repacked when their span moves, dropped when destroyed.
topConcern: A figure detached but not destroyed stays listed and walked each frame.

title: The hair clip through the stencil (silhouette boxed, clipping, put away, reboxed)
oneLine: Per-silhouette box lifecycle and per-hair mask choice for clipping hair under hats and hoods, plus a once-per-page install.
topConcern: Install is decided once per page; a rebuilt WebGL1 renderer would still route silhouettes to the GLSL3 clip batcher.

title: Your look's selection stores (seeded from this device, overwritten by the record on every join, changed in the world)
oneLine: Twenty localStorage-seeded look stores, re-applied from the creation-time record on every state_sync.
topConcern: Taking the t-shirt off in the world reverts on any reconnect: the record's st is stamped on the join and re-applied.

title: The six recoloured head-piece copies (hair, hat, beard, glasses, eye style, shirt)
oneLine: Six pasted LRU recolour caches: absent, baking, ready, evicted and freed 30 s later; the fallback to the colour numbers.
topConcern: Hat, eyewear and eye style leave a key 'loading' forever if one recolour throws (e.g. a null iOS canvas context).

title: Species art: meta loading, pictures retried later, per-skin builds evicted
oneLine: Species art load with its own retry-later rounds, a six-build LRU freed late, and an uncapped portrait-canvas map.
topConcern: A failing meta.json is refetched as fast as it fails while a figure wearing the species is drawn: no backoff.

title: A head piece's picture load: asked, timed out, asked twice more, given up
oneLine: Per-request three-attempt load with a 20 s timeout and a done-flag against late answers.
topConcern: After the third failure the recolour entry is made without that facing and never rebuilt until evicted.

title: The drawing editor's op list
oneLine: Each canvas's base plus op list, kept only while it replays to the stored art (the drop rule).

title: The cape you wear (the worker's ledger, mirrored)
oneLine: Server-owned worn cape mirrored into a localStorage-seeded client store from player_state.
topConcern: bt_cape is per device: another character on the phone shows the cape locally until the worker's first emit.

title: Derived look data handed in by the renderers (block arm frames, fishing rod shape)
oneLine: Module slots filled after each bake, read through source-identity and destroyed checks.

title: A stand-in's garb: memo keys and the 400 ms re-bake wait
oneLine: Memoised trouser/shoe pattern garb with a debounced re-bake the unsubscriber cancels.

title: Pose tables that drive other slices' animation phases
oneLine: Drawing halves of the townsfolk work routine and the dodge roll's head placement.
topConcern: A townsperson flips between work pose and standing as the palette's pose availability changes; deliberate.

title: The ?headframes probe and its on-screen readout (QA only)
oneLine: QA-only per-frame head-piece counters with a DOM readout made, refreshed and removed.

title: The creator's thumbnail warm-up (once per page, held)
oneLine: One-shot prefetch of the creator's trait thumbnails, the Image objects held for the page.
topConcern: All 64 thumbnails (about 3.1 MB if decoded) held after the creator closes.
